answer:
The Guest wifi note now has an app on its App side that shows a big QR code. Guests scan it with their phone camera to join the network.

It shows "Lindgren Guest" and the password underneath the code. It reads the Network, Password and Security lines from your note, so if you change the password, the code updates itself. I haven't scanned it with a phone, so try it once.

`check_app` reports one issue: the QR code sits on a fixed white background. I left it that way on purpose, because a white background is what lets cameras read the code reliably, in dark mode too.
